name: Test agent
description: A scripted agent for the framework's tests and the QA copy's native checks (graph-integrity G2.4). It serves its own threads through ctx.graph and answers each message with a reasoning step, a command step and a streamed reply. Its chats open to its own view (renderer.mjs: its ThreadView, drawn with the parts the framework lends; graph-integrity G2.2). No model traffic.
